expected_useful_output: Complete original128-sector/full-PW screened-joint Gamma forward total-force response to the same original Ni1/x momentum kick; if capped, genuine durable RK4 stage/edge progress and measured cost, not a fabricated completed q.

forecast.policy: per-edge immutable RK4 accumulator/input replacement; no reusable full-state scratch
forecast.rss: edge-local arrays/operators and grids; mmap page cache is reclaimable
forecast.peak_expression: existing unrelated bytes + max_over_exact_schedule(prior outputs*Q + live frames) + max(5Q+M+P, 4Q+2E) + live headers/receipts/reservation slack; production resume adopts existing seed/continuation without a Q copy
forecast.frame_policy: After a durable stage, retire only times absent from ALL remaining stages/readout and BOTH pair legs. Unscheduled standalone calls retain frames. Genuine material boundary frames alias existing history; no assumed future endpoint aliases.
forecast.checkpoint_policy: Only current/final propagation payload retained; obsolete stage/interval payload retired after durable replacement. Compact checkpoints/attempt/cost/retirement receipts remain. Returned checkpoint list contains the current final checkpoint only.
forecast.storage_policy: QBudget caps live reservations separately from cumulative write/action cost. Failed uncommitted arrays reclaimed before retry; completed RHS/edge progress retained until durable successor.
forecast.recovery: Authenticate latest interval, then whole stage or per-edge completed prefix plus immutable RHS. No mutable scratch adoption. One writer per work directory.
forecast.limitations: Payload expressions exclude JSON/filesystem overhead and failed-attempt reservation slack, which are measured/charged. Shared times needed by the second leg may still dominate disk on long grids. Unrelated or explicitly external checkpoints are never retired.
forecast.memory_policy: Parent plus pinned child RSS watchdog; no all-q allocation, no PW-square matrices.

runtime_expectation: Whole-q time is unmeasured. This1800s pilot measures actual phase/stage progress; first scientific inspection by15min and Root decision by20min. Active unit/CPU usage alone is not progress.
recovery: Existing authenticated whole-stage/per-edge progress retained; no duplicate writer and no free-resume promise for an unfinished native worker action.
limitations: SelectedGamma/coherent forward only, not two-time covariance, field noise, full64-q spatial response, a coherence window, numerical convergence or a lattice ranking. Split forward/pair needed by actual available disk; do not hold extra other-case mean states.
